scope: Exact Request and regarding-location GETs, location creator and parent GETs, exact Graph folder list, and refreshed visible workflow/plugin-step census; no writes or flow execution
limits: The original attempt-window receipt accurately found no location then; this later observation does not identify what created the location.

The production-only AsyncEntityCreated registration is a candidate to investigate, not proven to be the provisioner.
